title: One-step dual CRISPR/Cas9 guide RNA cloning protocol
protocol: Identify the target sequence for deletion.
Design SpCas9 sgRNAs with Cas-Designer or another computational tool.
Synthesise forward oligonucleotide according to the provided logic.
Synthesise reverse oligonucleotide according to the provided logic.
Synthesise oligonucleotides according to the given logic for Forward and Reverse primers.
Request oligonucleotide synthesis from a commercial vendor.
Prepare the PCR reaction mix as specified with all required components.
Initiate thermal cycling at 98°C for 30 sec followed by 30 cycles of 98°C for 10s, 58°C for 15s, and 72°C for 15s; hold at 12°C after completion.
Check the PCR product using 1.5% agarose gel electrophoresis for a clear band of 353 bp.
Purify PCR product with QIAquick PCR Purification Kit.
Dilute purified PCR product to 10 ng/µL in Nuclease-Free Water.

Digest 500 ng of the purified PCR product using the restriction enzyme corresponding to the primer used, following the same procedure as step 3 with 0.1M DTT and 10mM ATP but omitting vector and T7 ligase for 1 hour at 37°C.
Purify digested product using QIAquick PCR Purification Kit.
Dilute purified digest to 10 ng/µL.
Perform single-step digestion-ligation reaction as follows:
Mix 2 μl of 10X Tango buffer.
Add 1 μl of pX458 vector or similar (100 ng/μL).
Pipette 1 μl of PCR product (10 ng/µL).
Add 1 μl of 0.1M DTT.
Mix with 1 μl of FastDigest BpiI.
Combine with 1 μl of 10mM ATP.
Incubate with 0.5 μl T7 Ligase.
Mix 2 μL of 10X Esp3I Fast Digest Buffer.
Add 1 μL of lentiCRISPR v2 vector or similar (100 ng/μL).
Pipette 1 μL of PCR product (10 ng/µL).
Add 0.2 μL of 0.1M DTT.
Mix with 1 μL of FastDigest Esp3I.
Combine with 2 μL of 10mM ATP.
Pipette 0.5 μL T7 Ligase.
Add 12.3 μL Nuclease-Free Water.
Incubate for 6 cycles of (37°C for 5 min, then 23°C for 5 min).
Continue incubation at 37°C for 10 min.
Hold the reaction at 4°C.
Thaw competent cells on ice.
Add 2 μL of the ligation into the tube with 50 μL of competent cells and mix very gently.
Incubate on ice for 30 minutes.
Heat-shock the cells for 30 seconds at 42°C in a water bath.
Remove the vial from the water bath and place it on ice for 2 minutes.
Add 250 μL of pre-warmed S.O.C. Medium to the vial.
Shake horizontally at 37°C for 1 hour at 225 rpm in a shaking incubator.
Spread 50 μL from the transformation mix on a pre-warmed LB-agar plate with appropriate antibiotic resistance.
Invert the selective plate and incubate at 37°C overnight.
Pick one colony from the plate and inoculate 2 mL of LB Broth.
Incubate overnight at 225 rpm in an orbital shaking incubator.
Analyse by plasmid isolation with a miniprep kit, followed by Sanger sequencing using primer LKO or U6.
